Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages

package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages
Builder twins of the petstore console pages: each page's .ftlh file rebuilt with PageSpec, served when the page is requested with ?builder.

Each method mirrors its template card for card; PetstoreTwins_Test checks the two render the same page contract. The base chrome (base.ftlh: title, nav, badge, facts, scripts, footer) is not rebuilt: a spec with no page template renders inside the console mixin's chrome template, the same as an FTL page.

Example:

@RestGet(path="/") public View page(RestRequest req) { return builder(req) ? twin(req, OpsPageBuilders.audit()) : FreemarkerView.of("audit.ftlh"); }
